title: Storage of Edit Decision Lists on 3-1/2 in Disks
scope: This practice specifies the file and directory structure of 3-1/2 in floppy disks used for storage and interchange of edit decision lists (EDLs). The specification is by reference to International Standards for 3-1/2 in disk formats, more commonly known as the “generic DOS format.” This practice does not specify the contents of an EDL.
